sectionui.question.design: Does the interface match its reference, is it accessible and correctly directed, and do its states appear as declared?
sectionui.question.security: Does the project hold secrets, dependencies with known vulnerabilities, dangerous patterns, or permissions outside the policy?
sectionui.question.code: Does the project build, are its types and rules sound, and are its dependencies, references and size under control?
sectionui.question.behavior: Does the project do what its tests expect, alone and inside its host, and are its tests reliable?
sectionui.question.performance: Does it meet its declared performance and load budgets, recover, and work where it promises to?
sectionui.question.custom: Which checks of this project does AYAR not know?
sectionui.question.integrity: Can the results and the fixes be trusted?
sectionui.lastRun.never: No check of this section has run yet
sectionui.noCriteria: No criterion of this section is required, so it has no karat
sectionui.list.required: Required checks in the full scan ({count})
sectionui.list.folded: Folded · open it to select checks and run each one
sectionui.list.empty: No check of this section is in this project's full scan.
sectionui.optional.title: Optional and not included ({count})
sectionui.optional.note: They enter neither the full scan nor the karat until what they lack is there
sectionui.optional.lacks: What it lacks to become required
sectionui.notApplicable.title: Not applicable to this project ({count})
sectionui.notApplicable.note: Each with its reason; never selected
sectionui.custom.title: Custom checks ({count})
sectionui.custom.empty: No custom checks yet. Add one that runs a command of your project with a success criterion you set.
sectionui.custom.report.file: A JUnit or SARIF report the command writes
sectionui.custom.name: Name
sectionui.custom.idRule: The id is lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, up to 40 characters.
sectionui.custom.contains: Optional text the output must contain
sectionui.custom.successNote: The check passes when the exit code matches, and the text appears if one is set. The command never runs before it is approved.
sectionui.groups.title: Saved groups ({count})
sectionui.groups.note: They also appear in the Run menu of the title bar
sectionui.groups.name: Name
sectionui.groups.empty: No saved groups. Select checks, then «Save group…».
sectionui.panel.notRun: This check has not run yet.
sectionui.code.lastLog: Last log · {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} · {duration}
sectionui.code.noOutputs: The build wrote no declared output in this run.
sectionui.code.typesNote: {count, plural, one {# diagnostic} other {# diagnostics}} in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} of {total, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}. The files with the most diagnostics first.
sectionui.code.lintNote: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}. Warnings policy in the profile: {policy}.
sectionui.code.policy.warn: they do not fail the check and show as low findings
sectionui.code.noBudget: No budget is declared, so size is not judged. The check becomes required once a budget is defined.
sectionui.code.withinBudget: Every output is within its budget.
sectionui.code.unusedNote: In the full scan but not required, so it does not enter the karat. Nothing is removed automatically.
sectionui.code.complexityNote: An indicator of places to refactor, not a judgement of the code's quality. The suggested card is «Refactoring review».
sectionui.security.noUse: No call to it was found
sectionui.security.broad: A broad permission that needs a reason
sectionui.security.inPolicyFine: In the policy with its reason
sectionui.security.threshold: Failing threshold in the profile: {severity} and above; below it, a finding that does not prevent a pass.
sectionui.security.noVulns: No known vulnerabilities in the dependencies read.
sectionui.security.secretsNote: Values are hidden before they are kept, shown or copied, and never appear literally anywhere.
sectionui.security.noPatterns: No dangerous pattern found in scope.
sectionui.behavior.instancesNote: Each check instance stands alone with its result; the karat counts the required instances.
sectionui.behavior.countsNote: Inventory: {files} test files with {framework}. The counts come from the framework's report, not from an estimate.
sectionui.behavior.noFailures: No test fails in the latest execution.
sectionui.behavior.flakyNote: A flaky result is not a pass. «Test stability» finds flakiness by repeating the suite.
sectionui.behavior.host: Host results: the browser the extension runs in
sectionui.behavior.loaded: Loaded in {browser} with no manifest error
sectionui.behavior.workerRan: Started and kept running until the check ended
sectionui.behavior.consoleErrors: {count, plural, =0 {No errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}
sectionui.behavior.strengthNote: Surviving mutants by file: each is a small change no test failed for. Mutation score {score}.
sectionui.behavior.notMutated: Mutation testing has not run yet, so there are no surviving-mutant counts; that is why verified cards carry «test strength unproven».
sectionui.performance.measuresNote: A lab measure by the probe on the static build, with a declared processor slowdown; each value is the median of several loads. An unstable timing is shown and never judged.
sectionui.performance.noScenario: No load scenario in the project
sectionui.performance.compatNote: The browsers where a test failed, with the failing tests of each.
sectionui.performance.compatMatrixNote: A row for each browser or version the project declares it supports, and a cell with the result of each test in it.
sectionui.performance.compatAll: The compatibility tests passed in every declared browser.
sectionui.integrity.blocking: Blocks a ‹Pure› verdict: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
sectionui.integrity.noKarat: This section has no karat. Its checks watch the scan itself, so that a pass is real and not a trick, and they block a «Pure» verdict until their items are settled.
sectionui.integrity.checksNote: They run in every run, outside the score
sectionui.integrity.guardNote: Effects that make a check pass without a fix, compared with the previous round.
sectionui.integrity.guardFirst: This is the project's first scan round, so there is no earlier round to compare the tests, rules and thresholds with. The guard watches for silencing, skipping and changed references from the next round on.
sectionui.integrity.guardClean: No silencing, skipping or changed reference since the previous round.
sectionui.integrity.accepted: Accepted in your review · not blocking
sectionui.integrity.excluded: Excluded as a false alarm · not blocking
sectionui.integrity.rejected: Rejected in your review · the linked check failed
sectionui.integrity.outputs: the declared build outputs, not counted as a change
sectionui.integrity.stateStable: The start and end snapshots match in the source files: nothing changed during the scan.
sectionui.integrity.stateChanged: These files changed during the scan, outside the declared outputs:
sectionui.integrity.claimsNote: Notes from the model's report for {checks}. A claim never becomes a pass nor closes a finding: a local check proves it, or you decide.
sectionui.integrity.claimsNone: No model report in the project yet. When one arrives, its notes show here as «model claim» until a local check proves them or you decide.
sectionui.integrity.provenText: Became finding {finding} in «{section}»; source: model claim
sectionui.integrity.reviewsNote: Each review holds for its scope and expires when a file of its scope changes; its check then goes back to «needs review».
sectionui.integrity.expired: Expired: files of its scope changed
sectionui.integrity.renewed: A new review was recorded on {date}
sectionui.design.referenceNote: AYAR does not judge the interface's beauty; it compares it with a reference you define. No reference, no findings.
sectionui.design.ref.tokens: The design tokens AYAR compares the interface with.
sectionui.design.ref.fonts: The fonts allowed, so AYAR finds a silent fallback.
sectionui.design.ref.states: The declared states (empty, loading, error…) times the sizes, themes and languages.
sectionui.design.ref.target: What the probe renders: a static build, a local companion server, or a built extension.
sectionui.design.ref.targetDiscovered: Discovered from the build and not confirmed yet. Confirm it or define the local server's address.
sectionui.design.ref.baselinesSome: The images later captures are compared with, one per key.
sectionui.design.ref.tokensMissing: No design tokens reference in the project. Define the tokens file or its source to compare the interface with.
sectionui.design.ref.fontsMissing: No approved list of fonts. Define the fonts allowed so AYAR finds a silent fallback.
sectionui.design.ref.statesMissing: No declared states. Define the states (empty, loading, error…) times the sizes, themes and languages.
sectionui.design.ref.targetMissing: No render target. Define the static build, the local companion server or the built extension the probe renders.
sectionui.design.matrix: {states, plural, one {# state} other {# states}} × {sizes} × {themes} × {langs} = {total, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}}
sectionui.design.baselines: {count, plural, one {# approved image} other {# approved images}}
sectionui.design.candidateNote: A capture of the last run. Never approved automatically: review it, then approve it so later captures are compared with it.
sectionui.design.galleryNote: {shown} of {total} · the captures are kept locally
sectionui.design.diffNote: A visual change in {ratio}% of the pixels in the visual comparison design.visual. It finds the difference and does not judge whether it was intended: review it, then approve the capture as the reference or record that you reject it.
sectionui.design.a11yNone: No accessibility violation in the states checked.
sectionui.design.reviewNote: Items you check yourself; no automated check measures them. Each decision is recorded with its scope and expires when a file of its scope changes.
sectionui.design.item.screenReader: A screen reader on the main path
sectionui.design.review.itemsOnly: A review item is accepted or rejected; «false alarm» is for one finding.
sectionui.design.review.runFirst: Run the human review check once to record on it.
